title: Delegation result parser adds a false "Inconsistent result packet" note to an acceptance evaluator packet whose summary reports no findings
outcome: Delegation result parser adds a false "Inconsistent result packet" note to an acceptance evaluator packet whose summary reports no findings
acceptance: The verbatim output of evaluator delegation-1cb6b9bf-c637-474d-b745-c3ed348a05da (1136 bytes; its summary says only that criterion 1 passes and explains the 4097-byte marker and the pre-open callback; Findings: None) is added as a fixture, and its compact packet carries no "Inconsistent result packet" note.
Summaries that genuinely report findings while the Findings section says None still get the note. The existing fixtures in src/tests/delegation_result_summary_counts.rs keep their current outcomes.
A test bound to this item passes in the maintained full gate.
